audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on five of seven rows (full: Diana/Skill/Skill/Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill; content: Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Diana/Orianna), and the packet flags the chart as contradicting a 46.76% win rate by giving Orianna four stages to Diana's one.
audit.why: Orianna genuinely owns levels 1-2 — Diana has no dash until Lunar Rush at level 3. From 3 it is a skill stage, and from 4 onward Pale Cascade's shield plus an 825-range dash and then Moonfall put the lane in her hands until Orianna's two-item teamfight.
audit.corrected: Chart settled as Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Diana, Diana, Diana, Orianna — four Diana stages, which matches the sub-50% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content text claims "Diana has no gap-closer until 6".
audit.why: Lunar Rush is her E, learnable at level 3, 22s at rank 1 down to 14s maxed, and it costs nothing extra when the target is marked with Moonlight. Saying she has no gap-closer until 6 tells a player to walk up at level 4-5 into exactly the ability that kills them.
audit.corrected: early rewritten to say Lunar Rush is a 22s dash she can rarely spare, rather than that it does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number, and the Moonlight-reset interaction was asserted without the timers that make it usable.
audit.why: Crescent Strike (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6) applies Moonlight; Lunar Rush has no cooldown when it dashes to a Moonlit target, and casting it on anything else strips Moonlight. So the real sequencing is: dodge the Q and her dash is on its full 22s. Moonfall is 100/90/80 against Shockwave's 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rebuilt on those numbers; dos/donts bodies keyed to the 22s dash window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-three misgendering defects (Diana called he/his), two copy-paste bleeds, one unsupported magnitude, 'Command Attack' for Command: Attack.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists diana as female; the rest are deterministic lint findings.
